metadata.description: frugal - your agent finds the cheaper honest way before you pay.

plugins.name: frugal
plugins.description: A skill and a tiny local hook. Whenever a task involves paying for something (a SaaS plan, an API, cloud, a domain, a gadget, a flight), the agent runs a check sized to the amount: free and already-owned options, the right plan and billing period, startup, student, open-source and nonprofit programs, verified promo codes and cashback, negotiation, and cheaper alternatives. Every price is sourced, nothing against a vendor's terms, and it never pays by itself.
